name: Wholesale and retail trade

bnote.464907: Entero is India's main listed pharma distributor. The three US wholesalers handle most US drug distribution.
bnote.465101: India's two listed IT-hardware distributors, then the two largest abroad.
bnote.469000: No Indian general trading house with clean data (MMTC now has almost no revenue). Japan's trading houses are the closest match.
bnote.471100: DMart is India's largest listed supermarket chain.
bnote.471900: Listed Indian department-store and value-fashion chains, plus Target.
bnote.477101: Listed Indian apparel retailers, plus TJX and Ross.
bnote.477202: Nykaa sells beauty online and in stores.
bnote.479001: Meesho and FirstCry are listed Indian online marketplaces. Amazon, Alibaba and PDD are the largest abroad.
bnote.478104: CarTrade runs online used-car marketplaces and auctions in India.

flags.meesho: Listed in December 2025 and still loss-making.
flags.nykaa: Very high P/E because profits are still small relative to the market value.
flags.gpc: Net profit fell almost to zero because of one-off charges, so the P/E is not meaningful.
flags.lenskart: Listed in November 2025; P/E is very high.
flags.abfrl: After the Madura demerger, ABFRL keeps the Pantaloons and Style Up stores and is loss-making.

notes: Retail is well covered in India. Most wholesale niches have no listed Indian company, so large distributors abroad are used. Margins in trade are thin by nature; compare them within the same business only.
